text: Communication engineering is an engineering discipline that focuses on information transmission and exchange. It studies how to achieve efficient and reliable transmission of voice, data, images, etc. through various carriers such as electrical signals, optical signals, and radio waves. From mobile phone calls, 5G networks to satellite communications and fiber-optic broadband, the "interconnection" of human society relies on the technical support of communication engineering. It is the "nerve center" discipline of the modern information society.
